summary: Java for all 51 LRE requirements written under lre/ (controller, 5 operations, sensor, register, actuator, events, constants); compiles with javac --release 17. 13 points the requirements leave open are listed below; none blocks the pipeline.

issues.title: "-1 means no obstacle" conflicts with natural-number indices
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 declare cstc and cdyn as natural numbers yet say -1 means no obstacle; LRE-DM5/OP3/OP4 have closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1 when none exists. Java int becomes nat in the model and may never be negative.
issues.fix_directive: Kept the indices natural: ObstacleRegister.NO_OBSTACLE = 0 is the 'none' value, and register identifiers start at 1 (put rejects index 0). The distance functions return the safe large distance for index 0, so the guards behave as the requirements intend for -1. Confirm 1-based identifiers are acceptable.

issues.title: Value of the 'safe large distance'
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires odist/hdist/vdist to return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists, without giving a value.
issues.fix_directive: Chose 1000.0 m (Sensor.NO_OBSTACLE_DIST, private to the sensor), far above every 1 m threshold. Field accessors return 0.0 as DM5 states.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: The system description says HCM runs at reduced speed 0.1 m/s; LRE-FR3 says on entering HCM the LRE advises 0 m/s.
issues.fix_directive: Followed the requirement: HCM_VEL = 0.0. (0.1 would also round up to 1 in the model's constants, equal to MOM_VEL.)

issues.title: CPA formulation in CalcCPA
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names the inputs (relative position, obstacle velocity) but not the formula.
issues.fix_directive: Linear horizontal motion with closing velocity = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity; tcpa = (p.w)/(w.w); cda = sqrt of the squared horizontal miss distance plus vdist^2 (vertical separation taken as constant, obs_roc unused). A sum of squares, so never sqrt of a negative; with no dynamic obstacle vdist is the large default, so cda is large. If the closing velocity is exactly zero, tcpa and cda are NaN in Java: Beh8/Beh14 are false and Beh18 is true (no closing motion, no collision course). The division has no provably non-zero divisor if a verifier interprets it.

issues.title: Operations read the closest indices from the sensor, not from CalcCStc/CalcCDyn
issues.raw: LRE-OP2 and LRE-OP5 use the index computed by CalcCStc/CalcCDyn; the profile lets compute() use only sensor calls and the operation's own fields.
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA call sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex(), the same functions CalcCStc/CalcCDyn assign, so within one step the index is identical. step() runs CalcVel, CalcCStc, CheckOPEZ, CalcCDyn, CalcCPA before the guards.

issues.title: State variables live in the operation classes
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..8 say 'the controller maintains' each variable; each is also 'set by' an operation.
issues.fix_directive: Each variable is a field of the operation that computes it, exposed by a getter of the same name; the controller owns the operations and its guards read the getters. No duplicate controller fields.

issues.title: Transition priority within MOM and HCM
issues.raw: All transition requirements share priority 8; none orders transitions that can be enabled together.
issues.fix_directive: Order: reqOCM (operator override) first; then inOpez -> OCM; then collision course -> CAM; then endTask / reqHCM; then the autonomous HCM triggers. Lower branches conjoin the negations of earlier guard-only branches. Among the HCM triggers Beh9, Beh11, Beh10 are ordered so that Beh11 stays satisfiable while staticObsVertDist = staticObsDfltVertDist; all three have the same target and action.

issues.title: Beh9/10/11 vs LRE-DC1
issues.raw: LRE-DC1 forbids duplicate transitions for the same source mode and trigger, while Beh9, Beh10 and Beh11 are three triggerless MOM -> HCM transitions.
issues.fix_directive: Read DC1 as one transition per requirement: three separate branches, made mutually exclusive by negated guards.

issues.title: HCM -> MOM oscillation if staticObsDfltVertDist > staticObsVertDist
issues.raw: Beh13 (HCM -> MOM) needs vdist > staticObsVertDist; Beh10 (MOM -> HCM) needs vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist. Both autonomous.
issues.fix_directive: With the required defaults (both 1.0) the guards exclude each other. If the default vertical threshold were set larger, vdist between the two thresholds would cycle MOM <-> HCM without an event. Not guarded further, to keep Beh13 as written.

issues.title: Literal thresholds as their own constants
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 uses literal 1 (vel <= 1, odist > 1); Beh9/Beh11 use 1 m/s; Beh8/14 use tcpa >= 0; OP2 uses depth <= 0.
issues.fix_directive: Each is a separate constant (MOM_ENTRY_MAX_VEL, MOM_ENTRY_MIN_DIST, HIGH_HORIZ_VEL, HIGH_VERT_VEL, MIN_TCPA, SURFACE_DEPTH) rather than reusing minSafeDist; values as written. All constants are whole numbers, so the model's rounding does not change them.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: vvel is the rate of climb. LRE-Beh11 triggers on vvel >= 1 m/s.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally: only climbing at 1 m/s or more triggers Beh11; descending fast towards an obstacle below does not (Beh10 still covers vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist).

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre has no output
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: in CAM the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres. LRE-DM7 allows only advVel and advHdng and no requirement says what to advise in CAM.
issues.fix_directive: CAM issues no advice; its only behaviour is the exits Beh17/Beh18. An evasive velocity/heading needs a requirement.

issues.title: Initial values and the no-input cycle
issues.raw: No requirement gives initial sensor, actuator or operation values, nor how a cycle without operator input is presented.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor readings and actuator advice start at 0.0 (depth 0 means at the surface, hence in OPEZ until the first reading). Operation results start at 0/false; step() recomputes them before any guard, so they are never observed. step(null) is a cycle with no operator event.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, verifiers) and review these choices against its feedback.
